pieces.Text: You can summon a simple or martial weapon from your family's history that is appropriate for your current size. You are considered proficient with this weapon. You can use this ability for
minutes per day. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be used in 1-minute increments. The weapon disappears after 1 round if it leaves your grasp.
